title: Research Snacks: choose a check to read
purpose: Choose a relevant public claim check from its question and finding.
user: A field expert arriving from a shared link, returning from RSS, or looking for linguistics or economic history. No AI background or previous author posts assumed.

today.heading: Current front-page audit
today.text: One page combines site explanation and selection. Chronology, claim/verdict blocks, RSS and Linguistics work. Five unclassified entries sit under Research. Research minutes can be mistaken for reading time; long repeated text and retrospective titles make choice harder. This is an expert walkthrough, not participant testing.

commitments.text: Keep the cream compact publication, one header and all entry URLs; change the front page only.
Offer questions, findings and subjects with counts; make newest work and RSS easy to find.
Existing search and entry contents remain; no production publication before a preview and approval.

journey.step: First visit: recognise the purpose, choose a question, read the entry
Return from RSS: see latest additions and subscribe
Find a subject: narrow or jump, read a finding, open the check
